jobs.title: Software Engineer ServiceNow
jobs.description: We are currently looking for high performing individuals with experience of Service Now, wanting to be a part of our future journey! Are you the one we’re looking for? We are a small and dedicated team with a high level of independence and responsibility to ensure that we provide stabile operations and enable a great customer experience across segments, countries, brands and infrastructures. You will have great colleagues, always striving to improve working in a high pace environment, and at the same time have fun. If this sounds like the right challenge for you, don’t hesitate to apply! About the role As a member of the IT & Enterprise Service Management team, your role as a Software Engineer ServiceNow means you will have the full responsibility to operate, maintain and develop the ServiceNow on-prem platform and its capabilities, from infrastructure, application, kafka, integrations and other adjacent areas to the platform. The role includes on-call availability for critical incidents during non-business hours. The aim is to: Meet Tele2 business needs for highly available, reliable and secure services. This includes developing and enhancing our ServiceNow platform Achieve and improve the Service Level Requirements and Incident handling Full life-cycle management of solution Improve and retain service quality, stability and performance Continuously drive automation and improvements coming in from the users and stakeholders of the platform Continuously standardize and document capabilities to minimize dependency on individuals Ensure support services are delivered with minimal disruption to systems, services, and overall platform operations. Manage all Software upgrades, patches and additions of new Software and/or applications to the existing solution including security To be successful in this role, it’s key to be curious and understand the underlying processes and business needs for improvements to be able to proactively suggest improvements and solutions that are optimal to manage and support over time. This means focusing on ServiceNow capabilities that are out-of-the box for ease of maintenance and stability. Collaboration is key and a solution oriented and forward leaning attitude are an important part that defines our work culture. What we look for We believe you have a strong drive and the ability to be self-motivated. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, taking full responsibility for solutions end-to-end. You have prior experience operating, developing and managing a ServiceNow on-premises instance and are well-versed in the prerequisites and operating procedures required. Your collaborative spirit shines through, making you an excellent team player who contributes effectively to group efforts and connecting with various parts of the organization as well as external parties. You communicate clearly and with ease, setting right expectations and enabling seamless interaction both individually and in group/project settings. Your ability to engage with other people and navigate successfully within diverse teams makes you an asset to any professional environment. You have a passion for enabling improvements and finding new ways to enable them. jobs.title: Filed Service Manager - Scanjet in Gothenburg or Sjöbo
jobs.description: About Scanjet Scanjet Marine & System AB, a part of the Alfa Laval Group, is a world-leading and innovative company working with equipment for cleaning and level sensing for marine and land-based oil and chemical tanks. Scanjet was started in 1987 in Sweden where the headquarter remains today. Scanjet has sister companies with sites in Bulgaria, the Netherlands, Poland, Norway, the UK, Shanghai and Indonesia. With these strategic geographical locations and a strong customer focus, we have successfully established ourselves as a world leader in our sector. We have a major focus on future products designed to meet strict industry standards as well as environmental requirements. In our everyday work we are guided by our core values; customer-focused, professional and committed, cost-efficient, and keeping our promises. We are a workplace for everyone, and our success is built on a culture of diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants from various backgrounds and experiences. Scanjet is now looking for Field Service Manager to join our After sales organisation. About the role This role is responsible for leading Scanjet's Service organisation consisting of 20 employees, Field Service Engineers and Service Coordinators, across Europe and Asia. In this role you will report to the CEO, work closely with other managers within Aftersales and other parts of Scanjet as well as interact with Alfa Laval service & AS organisations. The position is full-time and will be based in either Gothenburg or Sjöbo in Sweden. In this role you can expect to travel approximately 60 days per year. Key responsibilities Lead Scanjet's global Service organisation, with overall responsibility for people, performance, budget, and sustainable business growth. Drive Scanjets cooperation with Alfa Laval's Marine A/S organization in Business Unit MAS and Framo and make sure that best practice is used. Develop and maintain a professional, customer-focused service network for Tank Management. Foster a strong customer-centric culture across the Service organisation. Drive the continuous development of global service operations, ensuring efficiency, safety, regulatory compliance, and high service quality. Lead the implementation of tools, processes, and ways of working that improve operational effectiveness and customer value. Lead, coach, and support team members throughout the employee lifecycle, creating an engaging and inclusive work environment. Oversee service partner agreements, competence development, and service documentation to ensure quality and consistency. Qualifications To succeed in this role, we believe you have the following required qualifications: Relevant education or equivalent work experience. Proven experience leading a service organisation or a company where service is a core business offering. Strong business acumen and commercial mindset. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across different countries, cultures, and regulatory environments. Solution-oriented, positive, and collaborative, prestige-free attitude. Proactive, and results-driven with a hands-on approach. Flexible mindset and ability to adapt and thrive in an international environment. Professional proficiency in both English and Swedish, with the ability to communicate effectively in an international business environment. Not a requirement but nice to have: Experience in a leadership or manager role, with demonstrated responsibility for driving business performance and organizational development Hands-on experience managing field service operations within a mechanical and/or electrical engineering environment. What we offer At Scanjet, you will join a friendly and dynamic workplace with an entrepreneurial spirit. You will have the chance to collaborate and grow together with committed colleagues and to contribute toward the future development and success of Scanjet. We have a strong track record of internal career development

jobs.title: Team Manager - Service
jobs.description: Silex Microsystems is the world’s leading pure-play MEMS foundry. We customize MEMS solutions for prominent global clients in industries such as pharmaceuticals, consumer electronics, and the automotive industry. We were founded in 2000 in a KTH lab by, among others, current CEO Edvard Kälvesten. Our headquarters and factory are located in Järfälla. About the role Silex team is growing and to support our growing organisation we are now adding four experienced and structured Team Managers to lead and develop our Service Team within Manufacturing. We are looking for Team managers for below areas: Plasma etch and DRIE Plasma Dep and Furnace Lithography and Bond Wet Chemistry, Analysis and Backend In this role, you will have a key responsibility for your team’s performance, development, and daily operations. You will combine people leadership with planning, coordination, and follow-up of maintenance and service activities, working closely with colleagues across Manufacturing to ensure reliable and efficient production. You will be responsible for a team of about 10 Service Technicians. You will be part of a highly collaborative production environment where clear communication, structured planning, and continuous improvement are important. The role is well suited for someone who enjoys leading people while also having a big interest and experience in technology, maintenance, and production. Key Responsibilities As a Team Manager, you will lead and support a team of Service Technicians and ensure that the team has the right conditions to perform and develop. You will work closely with Area Managers, Engineers and other functions to coordinate activities, priorities, and resources. Besides the personnel responsibility, you will also be expected to work hands-on in the clean room together with your team. Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to: Lead, support, and develop Service Technicians through clear communication, feedback, and regular follow-up. Set and follow up individual and team goals and support competence development. Plan, coordinate and if needed, perform, maintenance activities and allocate work based on priorities, competence, and available resources. Coordinate activities and priorities with other teams and shifts. Follow up KPIs, maintenance activities, and agreed improvement actions. Identify and escalate issues, risks, and resource needs when required. Coordinate with external suppliers and service partners when needed. Contribute to a safe, reliable, and continuously improving production environment. We are looking for someone who We believe you have experience leading or coordinating people in a technical, production, or maintenance environment. You are comfortable taking responsibility, creating structure, and working with different stakeholders to move activities forward. You have: A bachelor’s degree in engineering or at least 10 years of relevant experience within mechanical, electrical, or industrial maintenance. Technical experience of equipment, maintenance, and production environments from a similar industry. Experience in leadership, coordination, and people management. Strong communication skills and the ability to support and develop others. Strong planning and organizational skills. The ability to prioritize and coordinate several activities in a dynamic environment. A structured and solution-oriented way of working. The ability to build good relationships and collaborate across teams and organizational levels. Fluency in English, spoken and written. Swedish is considered highly beneficial. More about the recruitment process We apply an ongoing recruitment process and therefore encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. To apply, please attach your CV and answer a few questions. In the process, we work with a competence-based approach, which will include a personality and logic test, as well as reference checks. jobs.title: Senior Manager Service & Solutions
jobs.description: Shape the future of our services and solutions business. We’re looking for a strategic, commercially driven leader who can turn customer needs into scalable offers, profitable growth and long-term value. About the job You set the direction for our current and future offer portfolio. Combining a strong customer perspective with commercial ownership, you develop services, solutions and business models that support Seco’s strategy and deliver measurable results. Working across teams, you establish the governance, capabilities and ways of working needed to scale the business globally. Job responsibilities Set and execute the strategy and plan for the services and solutions portfolio. Develop the portfolio and its business models, including Solva, reconditioning, Tool as a Service and technical training. Drive commercial and organizational transformation from product-focused offers to scalable services and solutions. Own financial forecasting and performance follow-up, taking corrective action to secure profitability, growth and return on investment. Develop strategic partnerships and external ecosystems that support business growth. Build and develop a high-performing global team with the capabilities required to meet current and future demands. Location and flexibility The location for this position is flexible globally. The role sits within Customized Offer, Offer and Innovation at Seco, and travel is a natural part of the job. Your profile You have extensive relevant experience in offer and portfolio management, supported by strong commercial and business development expertise. You translate strategy into measurable financial and operational results and use sound judgment to prioritize investments, create business value and strengthen long-term competitiveness. You also bring Business performance ownership and commercial acumen, including forecasting, pricing, cost structures, margin improvement and corrective action. A growth and market development mindset, connecting customer needs, market trends, the services and solutions offering and business priorities. The ability to shape and govern an offer portfolio throughout its lifecycle, balancing customer value, complexity, scalability, innovation and long-term strategic fit. A track record of improving responsive and consistent customer value delivery through scalable ways of working, clear governance and cross-functional collaboration. The ability to lead and develop global teams, strengthening the competencies, capacity and ways of working needed for current and future business demands. A relevant university degree, such as an MSc in engineering, business development or an MBA, or equivalent professional experience. Strong written and spoken English and a willingness to travel. Strategic and customer-focused, you identify opportunities and move them forward with clarity. You build effective networks, align stakeholders across functions and divisions, and bring structure to complex decisions. As a leader, you develop people and capabilities while maintaining focus on customer value, profitable growth and sustainable performance. The team You lead a global team of Offer Managers responsible for reconditioning, Solva, Tool as a Service, training and future offerings.. The team works closely with customers and stakeholders across Seco and with other services and solutions organizations within Machining. Our Seco culture At Seco, we’re united by collaboration and a shared curiosity to learn and grow. We take responsibility for our actions, stay focused on our customers and believe in winning together. Our diversity provides a strong foundation for achieving great results. Curious about our workplace and benefits? Read more on our website. You’re also welcome to visit us on LinkedIn or Facebook to learn more about us and our products.
